story: If Everyone Hates Spirit Airlines, How Is It Making So Much Money?
text: Probably filling seats on unpopular routes that they would have to fly anyway. Perhaps in a similar situation to what's described in [VIDEO] , where an airline was flying empty planes to hold their slot at Heathrow.

story: Airlines flying empty planes to keep flight slots during coronavirus outbreak
text: Yep. Featured on HAI a year ago, it's not a new practice it's just been exacerbated due to COVID-19. [VIDEO]

story: Lufthansa confirmed that 18k flights had been flown empty to keep slots
text: This existed pre-COVID but is more of a thing now. See Half as Interesting - Why Heathrow Airport Had Empty Flights to Nowhere (3 years ago, pre-covid) [VIDEO] RealLifeLore2 also covered the same topic as the original submission: [LINK]
